    c(2.5, 1.5, mean(z[2:3, 1:2]), 1),
    c(1.5, 2.5, mean(z[1:2, 2:3]), 1),

  depth <- facets %*% p
  paste(c('red', 'green', 'blue', 'yellow')[order(depth[, 3], seq_along(depth[, 3]))], collapse = ',')
